    Changelog

    0.4.0 - 2026-08-09

    Added

    • Added the render-free Send Signal destination node with one Multi Enter input and no output.
    • Added Database and Custom addressing for Signal outputs, Send Signal destinations, and Signal Portals.
    • Added Signal.Send(string, string), Signal.Send(UIKey), and Signal.Send(string).
    • Added compile-time diagnostics for empty destinations, invalid Enter connections, and missing matching Portals.

    Changed

    • Unified NavButton and code requests under the Signal trigger and Signal catalog.
    • Custom Signal matching is ordinal and case-sensitive.
    • Restyled Send Signal and Portal inspectors as aligned cards and fixed UIKeyPicker field and Add-button layout.
    • Cached Graph Inspector input bounds instead of allocating an element list on every Geometry change.

    Removed

    • Breaking: removed Pivot and its rotation styler. Connect simple routes directly or merge routes through Send Signal.
    • Breaking: removed UINavigationEvents.RequestSignal, ButtonSignal request APIs, and the graph UI Button trigger.
    • Removed the legacy NavElement.start-hidden attribute; use Startup On Start.

    Fixed

    • Reset runtime View registries correctly when Enter Play Mode skips Domain and Scene reload.
    • Wait for valid layout before preparing Move transitions from display: none.
    • Prevent UI Builder preview elements from replacing Player Views in the registry.
    • Delay the initial graph transition briefly so Player Views can register.

    0.3.1 - 2026-08-04

    • Removed legacy UIViewId, UIAnimationPreset, and UIViewVisibility.Preset.

    0.3.0 - 2026-08-03

    • Added code-first graph authoring, Portal handles, and the Portal Condition inspector card.

    0.2.0 - 2026-08-02

    • Added panel-local LIFO popups, NavElement Startup, Category/Variant transitions, and scene/application Action nodes.

    0.1.0 - 2026-07-28

    • Added Graph Toolkit authoring, runtime graph import, Key Catalog, and UI Builder address pickers.
